title: Source Fetch Record
description: Per-source fetch metadata written by the Phase 6B fetcher. Stored at research/runs/<run-id>/fetched/<source_id>/metadata.json. The fetcher writes this file atomically after a successful exchange; a record may be either successful or a recorded failure (status='failed').

final_url.description: The URL after following all redirects. Equal to requested_url if no redirects were followed.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the fetch exchange in milliseconds.

fetcher_version.description: Version of tools/research-fetch-sources.py that performed the exchange.

artifact_path.description: Relative path under research/runs/<run-id>/ to the response artifact (response.html or response.txt).

fetch_result_path.description: Relative path to the fetch-result.json file for this source.

resolved_ips.description: All IPs the hostname resolved to at fetch time. Captured for the audit trail.

redirect_chain.description: Sequence of 3xx Location values followed, in order.

error_message.description: Human-readable reason when status='failed'. Never contains credentials or page body content.
